articles.author: YouTube Golf
articles.description:
TL;DR


Europe edged out the U.S. 15–13 at Bethpage Black to reclaim the 2025 Ryder Cup, overcoming a raucous American crowd and a late Stateside charge. Behind the scenes, the so-called “envelope rule” sparked plenty of chatter about clutch captain’s picks and strategy.
Looking ahead, golf’s biggest team event may never be the same: unruly fans on both sides, envelope drama and Europe’s resurgence all raise fresh questions about formats, course setups and whether the U.S. can reclaim home-field mojo in 2027.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Golf.com: Secret Envelopes, Unruly Fans, Europe Domination: Unpacking the 2025 Ryder Cup

articles.author: YouTube Golf
articles.description:
In this upbeat clip, the Bryan Bros hit the links with the US Junior Champion, sharing all the thrill and camaraderie of trying to beat the titleholder. Their excitement is contagious as they celebrate every shot and invite fans along for the ride.
Along the way they drop links to their newsletter, Discord, Twitch channel and stack of sponsor gear—from Rhoback apparel and Foresight Sports launch monitors to Bushnell rangefinders, LAB putters, Takomo clubs and Bruce Bolt gloves.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Bryan Bros Golf: Can We Beat the US Junior Champion?

articles.description:
Golf Match with Llama Caddies (1v1 Strokeplay)


Bryan Bros teamed up with Mark, Sandy & “Eggs” for a hilariously unpredictable stroke‐play duel—complete with llama caddies! They invite you to join the fun on Discord and Twitch, and to sign up for their newsletter at thebryanbrief.com for more shenanigans.
Gearheads, take note: they’re loving the Foresight Sports QuadMax launch monitor, Bushnell Pro X3+ laser rangefinder, LAB Putters (10% off with code bryanbros), Takomo clubs, Rhoback apparel (15% off), and Bruce Bolt gloves (free shipping with code BryanBros). Don’t forget to subscribe on YouTube and follow on Twitter, Facebook & Instagram!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Bryan Bros Golf: Golf Match with Llama Caddies (1v1 Strokeplay)

articles.author: YouTube Golf
articles.description:
In this video, coach Danny Maude breaks down a quick mental shift to help you finally square up your driver, nail your irons, and add effortless power to every swing. By quieting overthinking and focusing on swinging slightly inside-out, you’ll start hitting straighter drives and more consistent iron shots without battling your own head.
He peppers in simple drills, a step-by-step practice plan, and links to free resources and a supportive community. Whether you’re new to golf or chasing a lower handicap, grab these easy-to-apply tips, hit the range, and watch your game transform.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: Danny Maude: How To Learn Golf So Fast It Feels Illegal

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
TL;DR


Game Theory digs into just how insanely powerful Donkey Kong’s punch really is—breaking down his Smash move, supercharging it in the new Donkey Kong Bananza on Switch 2, and throwing in real-world physics to see if DK could actually destroy everything in his path.  
They also plug Boot.Dev (grab 25% off with code THEGAMETHEORISTS), announce their fresh Theorywear merch, and link you to Donkey Kong Bananza. Shout-out to writers Tom Robinson & Zaech Stew, editors Axellent, Koen Verhagen, Marc Schneider & Jerika, plus sound designer Yosi Berman for making it all happen!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: The Game Theorists: Game Theory: How DEADLY Is Donkey Kong's Punch?

articles.description:
C4SH, the wild-card Vault Hunter of chance, was unveiled at Tokyo Game Show 2025 as part of Story Pack 1: Mad Ellie and the Vault of the Damned, arriving in Q1 2026. Included in the Super Deluxe Edition or Vault Hunter Pack, this add-on drops you into a new Kairos zone packed with main and side missions, fresh gear, cosmetics and of course, C4SH’s dice-rolling, card-flipping shenanigans (animation by Rupert Gruber).
Borderlands 4 amps up the mayhem with billions of guns, up to four-player co-op and slick traversal moves like double jumps, gliding and grappling. Take on the iron-fisted Timekeeper, rally a resistance and smash through mech monstrosities, bandits and beasts in this over-the-top looter shooter.
Watch on YouTube

Deployment begins October 10—lock and load!  
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: GameSpot: Battlefield 6: Official Launch Live Action Trailer

articles.description:
Call of Duty NEXT Showcase 2025 Livestream


Get hyped—the Call of Duty NEXT Showcase is dropping on September 30th at 9 AM PT with all the juiciest reveals. Expect live gameplay premieres of Black Ops 7 Multiplayer and Zombies, fresh Warzone content, plus a special six-year celebration for Call of Duty Mobile with its own live demo.
Stick around after the main event for the CODE Bowl, where things get even crazier. Don’t miss out!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: GameSpot: Call of Duty NEXT Showcase 2025 Livestream (Black Ops 7 Multiplayer, Zombies, Warzone & more)

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Ghost of Yotei: PS5 Pro Ray Tracing Showcase

Dive into the first 35 minutes of Ghost of Yotei running on a PS5 Pro in its Ray Tracing Pro mode. You’re treated to smooth 60fps action, super-realistic lighting effects and an upscaled 4K image that brings the eerie mountain vistas to life.
If you’ve been curious about next-gen visuals, this gameplay demo nails it—shadows, reflections and all the little details pop like never before. Perfect for fans hungry to see what the Pro hardware can really do.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: GameSpot: 35 Minutes of Ghost of Yotei on PS5 Pro with Ray Tracing 4K/60

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Hollywood is freaking out over Tilly Norwood, the latest AI “actress” cooked up by Particle 6’s Eline Van der Velden. SAG-AFTRA and real actors are stunned that talent agencies might sign software that could end up snatching gigs from flesh-and-blood performers.
In other news, the 2D Terminator game No Fate got pushed back to November thanks to pesky global tariffs (but those sweet physical editions are still on track). And over at Capcom, the Resident Evil team is scratching their heads, wondering what actually counts as scary these days.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Hollywood Enraged Over A.I. 'Actress' Tilly Norwood - IGN Daily Fix

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
In this Hollow Knight: Silksong showdown, you tackle the optional Second Sentinel deep in the High Halls. Waking him up and triggering the Final Audience Wish is a quest in itself, but once he’s roused you can cozy up inside his guard to parry most blows—just remember that if he flips the move on you, your best bet is to leap straight up instead of backing off. Pop on the Weighted Belt if you want to stay on his grill and dish out fast, hard hits.
Gear up with a Hunter Crest for extra prowess, throw in a Cogfly for range, and wield your trusty Silkspear. Back you up with Druid’s Eye, Weavelight, Cogwork Wheel, Compass and a Magnetite Brooch to keep you on point. For deeper intel on builds and tactics, swing by our wiki at ign.com/wikis/hollow-knight-silksong.
Watch on YouTube
